'''Haemon Alde''' was<ref name="Ransom" /> a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]]<ref name="Death Mark" /> member of the noble [[House Alde]] from the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Alderaan/Legends|Alderaan]]. During the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]], Alde was kidnapped by [[Pirate/Legends|pirates]] from his protectors, who were in the service of Alde's ally [[House of Organa/Legends|House Organa]], and ransomed back for a large sum of [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credits]].<ref name="Ransom" />

==Behind the scenes==
Haemon Alde was first mentioned in the video game ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'', in the Underworld Training crew skill mission "Ransom Demands." The initial text for the mission refers to him as "Haemon Lear," but the completion text labels him as Haemon Alde and references the Organa family.
